models.name: HT-Demucs fp16
models.description:
Hybrid Transformer Demucs (HT Demucs) is a music separation model from Alexandre Défossez. It can split music into four tracks: bass, drums, vocals, and 'other' (guitar, keyboard, etc).

This fp16 version offers significantly better performance when running on the GPU at the cost of only slightly degraded quality.
